summary: Phase 33 — Claros Enroll (Admissions CRM) end-to-end testing. Backend: 34/34 pytest cases PASS covering all 11 /api/v1/enroll/* endpoints + 5 authorisation 403 cases (student delete/activity/ai-counsel; cross-tenant; registrar non-delete) + lead-score formula (6 parameterised + activity bump + status change recompute) + multi-tenant seed (ISB/EAIC/UoB all 30 leads, ISB sources distribution 15/7/5/3 verified) + ARISE legacy + Phase-32 Claros Core regression. Frontend (Playwright): /enroll Kanban renders with 7 stage columns, enroll-kanban-board + 49 lead cards (30 seed + 19 TEST_* leads I created during backend testing), enroll-add-lead-btn opens a sheet drawer with 6 input fields and enroll-draft-submit. Lead detail page (/enroll/leads/{id}) renders all expected testids EXCEPT enroll-detail-timeline (see frontend_issues). AI Counseling Script generation via Claude SUCCEEDED — 5 personalised bullets returned (verified personalised to student name 'Ananya' and program 'ECE'). Analytics page (/enroll/analytics) renders perfectly: enroll-analytics-summary + funnel (7 funnel-stage-* bars) + sources (4 source-row-* — WEBSITE/REFERRAL/EVENT/WALKIN) + daily (30 daily-bar-* bars).

coverage: PUT /leads/{id} status change — auto STATUS_CHANGE activity logged
POST /leads/{id}/ai-counsel — returns talking_points (5 strings, non-empty) + model field
POST /leads/bulk-import — CSV with 2 valid + 1 invalid → created=2/skipped=1
AUTHZ: student DELETE/activity/ai-counsel all 403; cross-tenant iid=ISB 403; registrar DELETE 403 (write but not delete role)

LEAD SCORE FORMULA verified for 4 rank/source combos: (1000,REFERRAL)=45, (18000,EVENT)=30, (10000,WEBSITE)=25, (600000,WALKIN)=0; status COUNSELED bumps +10 plus +10 from auto STATUS_CHANGE activity; 3 activities bump 45→65
MULTI-TENANT seed: ISB/EAIC/UoB all have total=30 leads; ISB source distribution WEBSITE=15/REFERRAL=7/EVENT=5/WALKIN=3 (matches spec exactly)
REGRESSION: /api/admissions/{iid}/leads + /api/arise/{iid}/scoring/score still respond <500; /api/v1/core/stats still returns total_students=20

frontend_results./enroll (Kanban): PASS — claros-enroll-kanban-page + enroll-kanban-board render; 7 stage columns NEW/CONTACTED/COUNSELED/APPLIED/OFFERED/ENROLLED/DROPPED visible; 49 enroll-card-* cards (30 seed + 19 backend-test TEST_* leads). Score bars + source labels + last-contact dates visible. enroll-add-lead-btn opens a drawer with 6 inputs + enroll-draft-submit.

ui_bugs.issue: data-testid='enroll-detail-timeline' not found on the timeline container. The activities themselves are visible (AI script auto-creates a NOTE entry, manual log works), only the wrapper testid is missing — likely on the parent <div> wrapping the activity items. Cosmetic / test-coverage issue only.

issues: The 'Daily new leads · last 30 days' bar chart appears largely empty visually — bars are present (30 daily-bar-* testids confirmed) but heights are very low because most lead activity is concentrated in the last few days. Cosmetic — consider scaling the y-axis or adding minimum bar height for non-zero days. Y-axis labels are also absent.

action_items: Add data-testid='enroll-detail-timeline' to the timeline container <div> in ClarosEnrollLeadDetail.jsx so playwright e2e for timeline visibility can pass. Cosmetic; no functional impact.

(Optional) ClarosEnrollAnalytics.jsx daily chart — add y-axis labels and ensure non-zero bars have a minimum visible height; currently most bars look invisible because today's spike dwarfs prior days.

(Cleanup) My backend tests created ~19 TEST_* leads in VCE tenant (visible in the Kanban / shifted NEW count from 8 to 25). All have email prefixes 'TEST_'; main agent may want to bulk-delete them: db.leads.deleteMany({email: /^test_/}) or rerun seed; the deterministic seed will NOT replace them.
critical_code_review_comments: routes_enroll.py (571 lines) is well-structured and uses {'_id': 0} projections throughout — no MongoDB ObjectId leakage.
compute_lead_score is pure and easy to test; spec coverage verified end-to-end against 4 parameterised cases + activity/status bumps.
get_optional_user dependency on the public POST /leads is correctly implemented; falls back to body.institution_id when user is anonymous; 400 emitted when neither present (verified by test).
ai-counsel endpoint has robust LLM fallback path: deterministic 5-bullet template if Claude fails. Verified end-to-end with real Claude — bullets are personalised with name + program correctly.
Bulk-import skips rows missing name/email silently — correct per spec; tested with 2 valid + 1 invalid row.
Cross-tenant guard _coerce_iid is enforced on every list/detail/update/activity/ai/analytics endpoint — verified 403 for VCE principal calling iid=ISB.
WRITE_ROLES correctly includes registrar but DELETE_ROLES does not — verified registrar receives 403 on DELETE.
Sidebar has 4 new entries: Pipeline / Analytics / Legacy Admissions / Advanced Console (visible in screenshot).

success_rate.frontend: 98% (all critical testids + flows pass; 1 missing wrapper testid enroll-detail-timeline)
